problem_statement: Claimants do not know what is happening with their home or auto claim, so they call the contact centre to ask, wait on hold, and feel anxious, especially customers who are not comfortable with apps.
vision: Every claimant always knows where their claim stands and what happens next, without having to call or log in.
target_users: Home and auto claimants, including older customers

epics.title: Proactive claim status updates
epics.summary: Tell claimants by text or email whenever their claim moves to a new stage, in plain language, with the next step.
epics.business_outcome: Fewer 'where is my claim' calls and higher claimant satisfaction during the claim.
success_metrics: Status-enquiry calls per open claim down 30% within 6 months of launch
Claim journey satisfaction (CSAT) up 10 points for notified claimants

features.title: Stage change alerts by SMS and email
features.description: When a claim reaches a new stage (received, adjuster assigned, inspection booked, documents needed, payment approved, paid), send the claimant a short message that explains the stage and what happens next.
features.benefit_hypothesis: If claimants are told about each stage as it happens, they will not need to call to ask, and status calls will fall.

stories.title: Capture contact preference and consent
stories.user_story: As a claimant, I want to choose whether I get updates by text, email or not at all, so that I am contacted only the way I agreed to.
stories.description: Ask for channel preference and consent when the claim is filed (online or by phone). Store the choice with a timestamp and source for audit.

acceptance_criteria.given: a new claim is being filed
acceptance_criteria.when: the claimant reaches the contact step
acceptance_criteria.then: they can choose text, email or no updates, and no option is pre-selected
no message is sent and the decision is logged
the new choice applies to the next message and the old and new values are kept with timestamps

stories.title: Send plain-language alert on stage change
stories.user_story: As a claimant, I want a short message when my claim moves to a new stage, so that I know what is happening without calling.
stories.description: Templates per stage, written at a reading age of about 9, with the next step and any action needed. Send within 15 minutes of the stage change.

acceptance_criteria.given: a claimant opted in to text updates
acceptance_criteria.then: they receive a text within 15 minutes naming the stage and the next step
it scores at or below grade 6 on a readability check and contains no internal jargon

features.title: Message history for claims handlers
features.description: Show handlers and contact centre agents every message sent to a claimant, when, through which channel, and whether it was delivered.
features.benefit_hypothesis: If agents can see what the claimant was told, calls that do come in will be shorter and answers will be consistent.

stories.title: Show sent messages on the claim record
stories.user_story: As a claims handler, I want to see every update sent to a claimant on the claim record, so that I can answer questions consistently.
stories.description: A timeline on the claim record showing time sent, channel, template, and delivery status.

acceptance_criteria.given: a claim with three messages sent
acceptance_criteria.when: a handler opens the claim record
acceptance_criteria.then: all three appear newest first with time, channel and delivery status
the failure is flagged and the reason is shown

stories.title: Spike: compare SMS delivery providers
stories.user_story: Find out which SMS provider meets delivery, cost and data-residency needs before the alert service is built.
stories.description: Time-box to 3 days. Compare at least two providers on delivery receipts, US data residency, cost per message, and opt-out handling.

acceptance_criteria.then: a short written recommendation with a cost estimate is attached to this issue

assumptions: The claims system emits an event or can be polled when a claim changes stage
Claimants' mobile numbers and emails are already captured at first notice of loss
open_questions: Which stages matter most to claimants in the first release?
Does compliance need to approve each message template before release?
out_of_scope: Filing a new claim by text
risks: Stage data in the legacy claims system may lag behind reality
Text messaging rules (consent, quiet hours) differ by state
